title: 10 Quick Steak Sauces
keywords: steak sauces salsa verde peppercorn bearnaise chimichurri black bean red wine teriyaki mustard blue cheese mushroom
ingredients: 1. Salsa Verde: Small bunch parsley, chives, mint, 1 tsp capers, 2-3 chopped anchovies, 1 crushed garlic clove, juice of 1 lemon, 3 tbsp olive oil
2. Smart Peppercorn: 2 tbsp white wine vinegar, 150ml chicken stock, 2 tsp green peppercorns, 4 tbsp double cream
3. Cheat's Béarnaise: 25g butter, 1 finely chopped shallot, 1 tsp white wine vinegar, 100g crème fraîche, 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1/2 tsp capers, small bunch chopped tarragon
4. Spicy Chimichurri: 1 garlic clove, 1 red chilli, small bunch coriander & parsley, 3 tbsp red wine vinegar, 2 tbsp olive oil
5. Black Bean & Sesame: 1/2 can black beans, 1 tsp dark brown sugar, 2 tsp honey, 1 tsp 5-spice, 1/2 tsp ginger, 1 red chilli, 2 tsp tahini, 2 tbsp cider vinegar, 2 tsp soy sauce, 5 tbsp water
6. Quick Red Wine: 250ml beef stock, 125ml red wine, 2 tsp dark brown sugar, 1 tsp balsamic vinegar
7. Teriyaki Sauce: 5 tbsp soy sauce, 3 tbsp sake, 2 tbsp mirin, 1/2 tsp grated ginger, 1 tsp honey, 1 sliced spring onion
8. Super-swift Mustard Sauce: 2 tbsp Dijon mustard, 100g crème fraîche
9. Blue Cheese Sauce: 25g butter, 1 tbsp flour, 150ml milk, 50g Stilton or blue cheese
10. Mushroom Sauce: 1 tbsp olive oil, 6 chestnut mushrooms (sliced), 1 garlic clove, 2 tbsp brandy, 4 tbsp double cream, 1 tsp wholegrain mustard
instructions: 1. Salsa Verde (15 mins): Chop herbs into small pieces. Mix in a bowl with capers, anchovies, garlic, lemon juice, and 3 tbsp olive oil. Season to taste.

2. Smart Peppercorn (20 mins): Put white wine vinegar in a non-stick pan, bring to simmer. Add chicken stock, reduce by half on high heat. Add green peppercorns (gently crushing a few), season, stir in double cream. Simmer 1-2 mins until thickened.
3. Cheat's Béarnaise (25 mins): Melt butter over medium heat, fry shallot 5-6 mins. Add vinegar, cook 2 mins. Stir in crème fraîche, Dijon, capers, tarragon. Simmer gently 2-3 mins.
4. Spicy Chimichurri (5 mins): Blitz garlic, chilli, herbs, vinegar in food processor until finely chopped. Add olive oil, blitz again, season, and refrigerate.

5. Black Bean & Sesame (20 mins): Put black beans, sugar, honey, 5-spice, ginger, chilli, tahini, cider vinegar, soy sauce, and water into a blender. Blend until very smooth. Pour into pan, simmer 5 mins stirring constantly until glossy and thick.
6. Quick Red Wine (25 mins): Pour beef stock into saucepan and reduce by half. Add red wine, sugar, balsamic vinegar. Leave to cook 10 mins over high heat until reduced by half again.
7. Teriyaki Sauce (20 mins): Mix soy sauce, sake, mirin, ginger, honey in small pan. Bring to simmer and cook 5 mins until thickened. Remove from heat and stir in spring onion.
8. Super-swift Mustard Sauce (10 mins): Mix Dijon mustard and crème fraîche in pan, heat gently until simmering. Season to taste.
9. Blue Cheese Sauce (20 mins): Melt butter in pan, stir in flour 1 min. Slowly whisk in milk until smooth. Bring to simmer, crumble in Stilton, stir until melted and thickened.
10. Mushroom Sauce (15 mins): Fry sliced mushrooms in oil 5 mins golden. Add garlic, brandy, cook until brandy evaporates. Stir in double cream and wholegrain mustard, simmer 2-3 mins.

title: Sourdough Bread (Starter Guide & Master Loaves)
keywords: sourdough starter wholemeal flour white flour levain pyrex dish Dutch oven proving basket kneading fermentation
ingredients: Starter Day 1: 50g wholemeal flour, 50g water
Starter Day 2: 50g wholemeal flour, 50g water
Starter Day 3: Discard 100g, add 100g wholemeal flour, 100g water
Starter Day 4: Discard 150g, add 100g wholemeal flour, 100g water
Starter Day 5: Discard 200g, add 150g wholemeal flour, 150g water
Starter Day 6: Discard 250g, add 200g wholemeal flour, 200g water
Starter Day 7: Ready to use
White Sourdough Dough (2 Loaves): 800g strong white flour, 10g salt, 460ml water, 320g sourdough starter
instructions: 1. Master Dough Mix: Add flour to bowl, mix salt through. Add water and starter, combine to rough dough.
2. Kneading: Turn out onto clean surface, knead ~10 mins until windowpane effect achieved (dough becomes smooth, soft, elastic).
3. Bulk Fermentation: Cover bowl with cling film, prove 4 hours at room temperature.
4. Knocking Back: Turn onto surface, knock air out to equalise temp. Shape into tight round ball.

5. Proving Basket Method: Dust basket with flour, place dough seam-side up, cover with tea towel, prove 3-3.5 hrs (or overnight in fridge). Preheat oven to 230°C/210°C fan with shallow tray at bottom. Turn dough onto dusted tray, score up to 1/2cm deep. Pour boiled water into bottom tray for steam. Bake 30-35 mins.

6. Pyrex Dish Method: Line 2.5L Pyrex dish with tea towel, dust with flour, place dough inside, cover with greased/floured lid, prove 3-3.5 hrs (or overnight in fridge). Flip dish over so bowl becomes lid, remove towel, score top 1/2cm deep, cover with bowl, and bake at 230°C/210°C fan for 25 mins covered, then 25 mins uncovered.
notes: Maintaining Starter: Store in fridge up to 10 days. Take out day before baking, refresh night before with equal parts starter, flour, water.

title: Sourdough Bread & Add-In Variations
keywords: sourdough bread starter flour rye water salt onion jalapeño olive cheese oats
ingredients: Base Dough: 333ml warm water, 200g sourdough starter, 500g bread flour (75g rye + 425g strong white), 5g salt
Caramelized Red Onion: 1 red onion finely chopped, salt & pepper, 1/2 tsp sugar, olive oil
Olive & Jalapeño: 60g black olives, 25g jalapeño slices (reduce water to 250g)
Sun-Dried Tomato & Olive: 60g black olives, 7-8 sun dried tomatoes (reduce water & add tomato oil)
Cheese & Black Pepper: 75-100g cheddar, 7g black pepper
Cheese & Jalapeño: 100g cheese, 50g jalapeños
Honey & Oat: Increase water to 400ml, add 90g honey & 120g rolled oats at mixing phase
instructions: 1. Pour water into bowl, add starter, stir to break up.
2. Add flour gradually, mix to rough dough. Cover, leave 30-60 mins.
3. Add salt. Perform 6 stretch-and-folds at 30 minute intervals.
4. Leave to rise until doubled in size.
5. Letter fold dough rectangle, shape into round ball, bench rest 15 mins.
6. Flour banneton/bowl, place dough seam-side up, rise overnight in fridge.
7. Turn onto tray, score, bake at 230°C for 35 mins with 200ml water tray in oven bottom.
8. Adding Flavourings: Scatter flavourings evenly across dough during the 4th stretch and fold.
notes: Always reduce base hydration when using wet add-ins like olives/tomatoes.

title: Raan (Roasted Spiced Leg of Lamb)
keywords: lamb raan leg of lamb roast yogurt ginger garlic saffron almonds cumin cardamom cloves indian
ingredients: 1 x 3kg (6lb) leg of lamb (trimmed, pricked & gashed all over)
Spice Purée: 125g fresh ginger, 12 garlic cloves, 1 lemon rind (grated), 5 tbsp lemon juice, 2 tsp cumin seeds, 1 tbsp cardamom seeds, 8 cloves, 1 tsp turmeric, 1 tsp chilli powder, 1 tbsp salt
Yogurt Glaze: 150g blanched almonds, 4 tbsp dark brown sugar, 300ml thick Greek yogurt
Sauce Finish: 1/2 tsp saffron threads in 2 tbsp boiling water
instructions: 1. Blend all Spice Purée ingredients into a smooth paste. Rub thoroughly over lamb, into cuts and gashes. Rest 1 hour.
2. Blend almonds, 2 tbsp brown sugar, and half the yogurt until smooth. Fold into remaining yogurt and rub over lamb. Cover and chill in fridge for 48 hours.

3. Sprinkle remaining 2 tbsp brown sugar over lamb. Roast in oven at 220°C for 20 mins, reduce to 180°C for 1 hr, then cover tightly with foil and reduce to 170°C for 4 hours until meat falls off bone.
4. Remove lamb, wrap in foil to rest. Skim fat from roasting pan, stir in saffron water, boil on hob 15-20 mins until sauce reduces by half. Serve reduction over carved lamb.
notes: Requires 2 days advance preparation for full flavor infusion.

title: J Sheekey's Fish Pie
keywords: fish pie cod salmon smoked haddock cream mash potato parmesan peas
ingredients: 125g skinless cod fillet (2cm cubes)
125g skinless salmon fillet (2cm cubes)
125g skinless smoked haddock fillet (2cm cubes)
250ml fish stock & 50ml white wine
Sauce: 25g butter, 25g flour, 90ml double cream, 1 tsp Dijon, 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp parsley, 1 hard-boiled egg (diced)
Topping: 500g mashed potatoes, 15g breadcrumbs, 10g Parmesan, 50g frozen peas
instructions: 1. Poach cod, salmon, and smoked haddock in fish stock and white wine for 2 minutes; drain and save the poaching liquid.
2. Melt butter in pan, stir in flour, gradually whisk in saved stock liquid, and simmer 10 mins until thick.
3. Stir in double cream, Dijon mustard, Worcestershire sauce, parsley, and diced hard-boiled egg.
4. Gently fold poached fish into sauce, transfer to pie dish, and scatter frozen peas on top.
5. Pipe or spread mashed potatoes over top, sprinkle with breadcrumbs and Parmesan.
6. Bake at 180°C for 30 mins, then flash under grill until golden.

title: Jerk Chicken with Rice & Peas
keywords: jerk chicken scotch bonnet spring onions allspice coconut milk kidney beans basmati rice
ingredients: 12 chicken thighs & 1 lime
Jerk Marinade: Spring onions, ginger, garlic, scotch bonnet, thyme, lime juice, soy sauce, oil, brown sugar, allspice
Rice & Peas: 200g basmati rice, 400g coconut milk, spring onions, thyme, 2 cans kidney beans
instructions: 1. Blend Jerk Marinade ingredients in food processor into a thick paste.
2. Slash chicken thighs deeply, rub marinade all over, cover and chill overnight in fridge.
3. Bake at 180°C for 45 mins (or smoke-grill over barbecue coals).
4. Rice & Peas: Bring basmati rice, coconut milk, spring onions, and thyme to a boil. Simmer covered 10 mins, stir in drained kidney beans, cover and steam off heat 5 mins.

title: Slow Cooker BBQ Beef Brisket
keywords: beef brisket slow cooker bbq sauce cider vinegar paprika garlic onion powder mustard slider
ingredients: 1.5-2kg beef brisket
Rub: Brown sugar, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, cumin, mustard powder, salt, pepper
BBQ Sauce: Garlic, cider vinegar, ketchup, brown sugar, Worcestershire sauce
instructions: 1. Rub brisket thoroughly with dry spice rub.
2. Combine BBQ sauce ingredients in bottom of slow cooker, nestle brisket inside, cook on LOW for 8-10 hours.
3. Remove brisket to foil. Pour slow cooker liquid into saucepan and reduce on high heat until syrupy.
4. Roast brisket in oven at 200°C for 15 mins, baste generously with reduced BBQ sauce, roast 5 mins more to caramelize.

title: Salted Caramel Peanut Brittle Brownies
keywords: brownies salted caramel peanut brittle dark chocolate peanuts
ingredients: Caramel Sauce: Caster sugar, double cream, sea salt
Peanut Brittle: Sugar, water, salted peanuts, bicarb
Brownie Batter: 250g butter, 250g dark chocolate, 4 eggs, 300g sugar, 1 tsp vanilla, 150g flour
instructions: 1. Peanut Brittle: Boil sugar/water to caramel colour, stir in bicarb and peanuts, pour onto tray, cool and crush.
2. Salted Caramel: Caramelize sugar in pan, whisk in double cream and sea salt; cool.
3. Brownie Batter: Melt butter and dark chocolate. Whisk eggs, sugar, vanilla; combine with chocolate and fold flour.
4. Assembly: Layer half batter in pan, drizzle caramel sauce, scatter crushed brittle, top with remaining batter, swirl with skewer. Bake at 170°C for 35-40 mins.

title: Slow Cooker Chicken Curry
keywords: chicken curry slow cooker baby potatoes Indian coriander turmeric garam masala tomato puree kid friendly gluten free
ingredients: 1 tablespoon Oil
1 cup finely chopped Onions
1 tablespoon minced Garlic
7-8 Baby Potatoes, halved
8 boneless, skinless Chicken Thighs (1-inch pieces)
1 Bayleaf, 2-3 Cloves, 6-8 Peppercorns, 1 Green Chilli
1 tbsp Coriander Powder, 1 tsp Red Chilli Powder, 1/2 tsp Turmeric, 1 tsp Garam Masala, 1 tsp Salt
1 cup Tomato Puree, 1/2 cup Water, 1 tbsp Butter, Chopped coriander
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a pan and saute chopped onions and minced garlic for 3-4 minutes until soft. Transfer mixture to slow cooker.
2. Add chicken thighs, halved baby potatoes, whole spices, ground spices, tomato puree, water, and salt. Mix well.
3. Cover and cook on HIGH for 3.5-4 hours or LOW for 6 hours.
4. Stir in butter and fresh coriander before serving over steamed rice or with naan.
notes: Recommend chicken thighs to retain juiciness.

title: Smoked Chipotle Chicken
keywords: smoked chipotle chicken rub smoked paprika garlic powder cumin coriander brown sugar smoker BBQ
ingredients: Chicken thighs or whole chicken
2 tsp chipotle powder
2 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp cumin, 1/2 tsp coriander
1 tsp salt, 2 tsp brown sugar
instructions: 1. Combine chipotle powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder, cumin, coriander, salt, and brown sugar into a rub.
2. Apply rub evenly all over chicken.
3. Smoke chicken between 120-130°C for 3 to 5 hours until internal probe in thickest part of thigh reads 74°C.

title: Smoky Hake with Beans & Greens
keywords: hake fish chorizo spinach cannellini beans smoked paprika red chilli lemon juice quick dinner
ingredients: 1/2 x 200g raw cooking chorizo
1 onion, finely chopped
260g spinach
2 x 140g skinless hake fillets
1/2 tsp sweet smoked paprika
1 red chilli, deseeded and shredded
400g can cannellini beans
Juice 1/2 lemon, 1 tbsp olive oil
instructions: 1. Squeeze chorizo meat into pan with 1 tsp oil. Add onion and fry 5 mins until browned.
2. Wilt spinach with boiling water, squeeze dry. Season hake fillets, sprinkle smoked paprika, drizzle oil.
3. Add chilli, beans, spinach, lemon juice, extra virgin olive oil to chorizo pan; warm through.
4. Grill hake under high heat 5 mins. Top bean mixture with grilled hake.

title: White Chocolate & Ginger Cheesecake
keywords: cheesecake white chocolate stem ginger butterscotch sauce gingernut mascarpone cream cheese wagamama
ingredients: Base: 300g gingernut biscuits, 100g butter
Filling: 300g cream cheese, 250g mascarpone, 150ml double cream, 400g melted white chocolate
Butterscotch: 50g caster sugar, 1 tbsp butter, 120ml double cream, 10g stem ginger, 1 tbsp ginger syrup
instructions: 1. Press buttered crushed biscuits into 20cm tin; chill 30 mins.
2. Whisk cream cheese, mascarpone, double cream, melted white chocolate; pour over base and set overnight.
3. Caramelize sugar, stir in butter, double cream, stem ginger, syrup; drizzle over cheesecake.

title: Best Yorkshire Puddings
keywords: yorkshire puddings batter eggs flour milk sunflower oil Sunday roast bbc good food
ingredients: 140g plain flour
4 eggs
200ml milk
Sunflower oil
instructions: 1. Drizzle sunflower oil into 12 muffin holes; heat in oven at 230°C (210°C fan) until smoking hot.
2. Whisk flour, eggs, milk until lump-free batter forms.
3. Pour batter into hot holes and bake undisturbed 20-25 mins.

title: The Best Spaghetti Bolognese
keywords: spaghetti bolognese beef mince bacon tomato parmesan basil oregano red wine
ingredients: 500g beef mince, 4 rashers streaky bacon
2 onions, 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks, 2 garlic cloves, rosemary
2 x 400g plum tomatoes, basil, oregano, bay leaves, tomato purée, beef stock cube, 125ml red wine
400g spaghetti, 75g parmesan
instructions: 1. Fry chopped bacon 10 mins crisp. Add chopped veg and rosemary; fry 10 mins soft.
2. Brown beef mince 4 mins.
3. Add tomatoes, herbs, wine, stock cube; simmer covered 1 hr 15 mins.
4. Stir in parmesan and serve over cooked spaghetti.
